title: Production Function Estimation with Measurement Error in Capital
Dynamic Games in Empirical Industrial Organization
(Mis)Allocation, Market Power, and Global Oil Extraction
abstract: We propose an approach to measuring the misallocation of production in a market that compares actual industry cost curves to undistorted (counterfactual ) supply curves. As compared to traditional, TFPR-based, misallocation measures, this approach leverages cost data, such that results are readily mapped to welfare metrics. As an application, we analyze global crude oil extraction and quantify the extent of misallocation therein, together with the proportion attributable to market power. From 1970 to 2014, we find substantial misallocation, in the order of US$744 billion, 14.1 percent to 21.9 percent of which is attributable to market power. (JEL D24, F23, L13, L71, Q35)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种衡量市场中生产错配的方法，该方法将实际行业成本曲线与无扭曲的（反事实）供给曲线进行比较。与传统的基于TFPR的错配衡量方法相比，该方法利用了成本数据，因此其结果可以直接映射到福利指标上。作为应用，我们分析了全球原油开采，量化了其中的错配程度，以及可归因于市场势力的比例。1970年至2014年间，我们发现存在大量错配，规模约为7440亿美元，其中14.1%至21.9%可归因于市场势力。（JEL D24, F23, L13, L71, Q35）

title: Nash-in-Nash" Bargaining: A Microfoundation for Applied Work
How Do Electricity Shortages Affect Industry? Evidence from India
abstract: We estimate the effects of electricity shortages on Indian manufacturers, instrumenting with supply shifts from hydroelectric power availability. We estimate that India's average reported level of shortages reduces the average plant's revenues and producer surplus by 5 to 10 percent, but average productivity losses are significantly smaller because most inputs can be stored during outages. Shortages distort the plant size distribution, as there are significant economies of scale in generator costs and shortages more severely affect plants without generators. Simulations show that offering interruptible retail electricity contracts could substantially reduce the impacts of shortages. (JEL D24, L60, L94, O13, O14, Q41)
abstract_zh: 我们利用水电供应的变化作为工具变量，估计了电力短缺对印度制造商的影响。我们估计，印度平均报告的电力短缺水平使得平均工厂的收入和生产者剩余减少了5%至10%，但由于大多数投入品可以在停电期间储存，平均生产率的损失显著更小。短缺扭曲了工厂规模分布，因为发电机成本存在显著的规模经济，且短缺对没有自备发电机的工厂影响更为严重。模拟结果表明，提供可中断的零售电力合同可以大幅减轻短缺的影响。（JEL D24, L60, L94, O13, O14, Q41）

title: Profitability Dispersion and Plant Selection in the Ready-Mix Concrete Industry
Two Wrongs Can Sometimes Make a Right: The Environmental Benefits of Market Power in Oil
abstract: Market power reduces equilibrium quantities and distorts production, typically causing welfare losses. However, as Buchanan (1969) noted, market power may mitigate overproduction from negative externalities. This paper examines this in the global oil market, where OPEC's market power affects oil production and carbon intensity. We estimate that from 1970 to 2021, OPEC's market power reduced emissions by over 67 GtCO2, equating to $4,073 billion in climate damages and 17.8% of the carbon budget needed for the 1.5 C Paris Agreement target. This environmental benefit outweighs the welfare loss from distorted production allocation.
abstract_zh: 市场势力会降低均衡产量并扭曲生产，通常造成福利损失。然而，正如Buchanan（1969）所指出的，市场势力可能会缓解负外部性所导致的过度生产。本文在全球石油市场中考察了这一问题，其中欧佩克的市场势力影响石油产量和碳强度。我们估计，1970年至2021年间，欧佩克的市场势力减少了超过670亿吨二氧化碳（GtCO2）的排放，相当于4.073万亿美元的气候损害，并占实现《巴黎协定》1.5摄氏度目标所需碳预算的17.8%。这种环境效益超过了生产配置扭曲所带来的福利损失。
